# GM coherent role candidates — NOT QUALIFIED

Exactly two historical BSC profiles, generated by the Rust `prepare_gm_role`
helper from the unchanged 431-profile baseline. Only the broad root-201,
width-two role rule is replaced, with the explicitly selected
`gm_token_solc_0_8_16_ondo_vendor` membership-201/set-251 template. No independent
membership or role-admin permission is added. Every other field restores exactly
by undoing that edit, including the four finite long-name payload words,
allowances, scalar metadata, both proxy hashes and the shared beacon dependencies.

`source-review.json` binds the three complete Phase A captures, compiler outputs,
primary inventory, source inventory, paired execution report and transcripts.
Historical Phase A files are unchanged. Reproduce offline using:

```sh
cargo run --locked --offline -p erc20-balances-tools --bin prepare_gm_role -- \
  /path/to/original/erc20/balances /fresh/output
```

Complete coherent operations only: the four legacy source one-sided controls,
dirty membership/index words, fragments and malformed array states are refused.
An operation that leaves no persisted writes creates no inferred observation.
The selected mode requires Extended v4/v5 with actual positive frame boundaries.

The five custom public-source gaps, null on-chain creation bindings, unknown
initial role-set coherence, real producer witness completeness and external
compliance/pause/beacon execution remain separate qualification requirements.
Saved-data parity does not qualify a replacement package or live deployment.
See [the focused review](../../../docs/gm-coupled-role-candidate.md).
